card.name: Thyroid and iodine test wording
card.fires_on: The word thyroid, or the middle of thyroid and radioactive iodine terms, in iodinated contrast labels about thyroid uptake and tests. Also fires on a few other spots such as a space after a comma in a list of sampling times.
